name: Cambodian Memorial Sites: From centres of repression to places of peace and reflection
description: Three sites in Cambodia preserve the memory of Khmer Rouge repression between 1971 and 1979: the early M-13 prison, Tuol Sleng (the former S-21 prison, now a genocide museum), and Choeung Ek, where S-21 prisoners were executed. Today they are places of remembrance and learning. Tuol Sleng also holds extensive archives and collections that were used in the tribunal's investigations.
